show.description:
In that village, a Brahmrakshasa is known for abducting brides on their wedding night.
Despite being aware of this terrifying truth, Eera arrives there to ensure her friend Nivi’s wedding takes place.
Will she be able to stop the Brahmrakshasan?
Watch “Brahmrakshas”, streaming exclusively on Kuku TV.
